SYMPTOM: `claude -p 'say hi'` takes 60-70 seconds even for trivial prompts
CAUSE: The xcode MCP server (`rust-analyzer-lsp` / `swift-lsp` plugins) starts but fails to respond to tool fetch, causing a 60s timeout before the API call proceeds.
Debug log showed: `08:10:13.615 MCP server 'xcode': Starting` → `08:11:13.656 Failed to fetch tools: MCP error -32001: Request timed out`
FIX: Use `--strict-mcp-config` flag — skips ALL MCP servers (no xcode, no ClickUp, no stitch)
  `claude -p 'say hi' --strict-mcp-config --model haiku --max-turns 1`
  Result: 6.4s instead of 68s
PREVENT: Always use --strict-mcp-config when spawning claude -p programmatically for fast one-shot calls
